description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named DbHealthController that provides a health check endpoint for database connectivity verification. It uses JdbcTemplate to perform a simple query and returns the status.

classes.name: DbHealthController
classes.description: REST controller providing an endpoint for database health check. It injects JdbcTemplate to execute a simple SQL query and reports database status.

methods.name: DbHealthController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with a JdbcTemplate instance for database operations.

methods.name: dbHealth
methods.description: HTTP GET endpoint at /health/db that performs a simple 'SELECT 1' query to verify database connectivity and returns the status.
